sentence: Whether US fair use doctrine permits the ingestion (in 2026; in litigation pending; outcome unsettled), whether the EU AI Act's Article 53 training-data transparency provisions apply, whether the Authors Guild settlement framework can be analogically extended — these are unresolved questions to which this protocol contributes evidence but not arguments.

title: Provenance Is What Authorship Must Endure
sentence: The Authors Guild "Human Authored" certification (expanded to all U.S. authors, March 2026), the Society of Authors scheme (March 2026), and analogous initiatives define human-authored work largely by excluding generative AI from the textual production process, with narrow exceptions for grammar checking or research support.
